email.subject1: a signal play for Solutions by Text
email.body1:
Anthony, saw Solutions by Text is acquiring Triple Play Pay, building on the $110M round and the FinText push.

Expansion like that usually drops more accounts on the SDR team than they can research and follow up on by hand. Our AI SDR handles the research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so your reps run 3-5x more meetings without you adding headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Solutions by Text off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Anthony, quick follow-up for Solutions by Text.

Most SDR teams lose hours to research and CRM logging that never converts, so response volume stays flat no matter how hard the reps push. The fix is rarely more activity, it is tighter sequencing and faster follow-up.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best-practice tweaks alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will show you exactly where yours leak.
email.body3:
Anthony, last bit of proof for Solutions by Text.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Anthony, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SDR output without new hires isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Folding in an acquisition is its own kind of busy on the SDR side, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Solutions by Text either way.
